SECOND AMENDMENT
to Lease Agreement
by and between
Naveed Shah ("Lessor") and Zameen Developments (Private) Limited ("Lessee")
[Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties"]
This second amendment ('Second Amendment") to the Lease Agreement dated 8th January,
2021 ("Lease Agreement") is made and entered into at Lahore on this 4th September, 2023.
WHEREAS
(A)

The Parties entered into the Lease Agreement wherein the Lessor granted on lease, and
the Lessee took on lease from the Lessor, an area measuring Seventy Five Hundred
(7500) sq. ft, on Ground floor of the building named and styled as "Mega Tower", located
at 63-B, Main Boulevard, Gulberg II, Lahore ("Demised Premises"); and

(B)

The Parties hereby mutually agree to revise and amend the Lease Agreement as per the
terms and conditions of this Second Amendment.

NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1.

The Second Amendment shall come into force on o1S January, 2024 ("Effective Date").

2.

Pursuant to Clause 2.1 of the Lease Agreement, the Parties hereby mutually agree to
extend the term of the Lease Agreement for a period of two (2) years, commencing from
the Effective Date and ending on 31st December, 2025 ("Extended Term").

3,

The Parties agree that the monthly rent is Rs. 616,383 (Rupees Six Hundred Sixteen
Thousand Three Hundred Eighty-Three Only) per month exclusive of all taxes ("Monthly
Rent"). For the avoidance of doubt, the annual increment (7.7%) on Monthly Rent will be
applicable with effect from 16th April 2024.

4.

All other terms and provisions in the Lease Agreement shall mutatis mutandis apply and
shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the
event of any conflict, the terms of this Second Amendment shall prevail, and any conflicting
term in the Lease Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately.

5.

This Second Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Lease Agreement.

6.

All expressions and terms defined or used in the Lease Agreement shall bear the same
meaning in this Second Amendment, unless otherwise specified herein.

7

This Second Amendment may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together
shall constitute one and the same amendment.
